page.layout: One page of Latin verse in one column, set in italic with roman capitals for names. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Gathering signature at the foot, centred left. No marginal notes. Faint mirrored show-through in the right margin, not transcribed.

main_text.p: Ipsa licet volvas operosa volumina sancti (tronus[?] RICHOMEI, summus IVDAITARVM esse pa- Qui modo sustinuit multis e millibus unus: Sutq; comes MARIANA, illisq; adiunge COTONE[?]; Omnia cognosces, propriisq; docebere libris. Non aliunde decet quam sint haec vera probari.

p.i: Insuper ah faciet miseranda Ecclesia cunctis Gallica nostra fidem, qua nunc sub pondere vasto Vix animam trahit innumeris oppressa statutis, Servitiumq; tuosq; Esanita[?] exosa furores, Antiquae deflet proh Libertatis honorem.

main_text.p: Aurea Libertas, sic,sic calcabere? sicne Illa tibi frenum iniiciet IVDAITICA pestis, Ultima fex hominum, Cacodaemonis excrementum, Quo nil terra tulit peius nec foedius unquam?

Ergone Libertas, quam tu LODOICE tuorum Virtute, & proprio peperisti sanguine, nobis Eripienda data est? Ergo hac tibi lege relictum A proavis, tritavisq; tuis BORBONICA proles FRANCORVM Imperiu? tandem circumspice, tandem Erige te, rursumq; antiqua imitarè tuorum Gesta patrum, priscosq; atavorum respice honores. Cessatum satis est; sanam tandem arripe mentem, Atque animo perpende tuo, tecumq; revolve, Officium praestare pium, civisq; fidelis, Qui quantum in se est, pro Libertate tuenda Prospicit Imp[illegible, ~3 letters], & Regi sua iura reservat Integra, quicq; [illegible, ~5 letters]t, ne quid Respublica damni Accipiat, prisco ve[?] suo videatur honore.

p.i: Contra etiam vestrum esse putã curare subinde, Ne quid forte novi perturbet publica rerum

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse in the right margin, not transcribed. Several damaged words in the verse: "Imp" line and "quicq;" line are illegible in part. "Esanita", "COTONE;" and "priscove" are doubtful. The opening parenthesis "(tronus" in line 1 is doubtful. Long s has been normalised to s, u/v adjusted per the rules. "volvas" and "renolve" were changed from the printed u.
